prompt: Vertical 9:16 steep high angle from the ceiling corner of a UK ambulance racing through rainy night streets, looking down on an older man lying on a black stretcher mattress, his grey face under an oxygen mask, shirt cut open, defibrillator pads on his chest, straps loose. Dropped gauze wrappers and tubing slide across the teal-green floor. Hard cold strip light from above, blue emergency light flaring through a side window, 24mm lens, 35mm film grain, underexposed, camera shake. Thanks.
